params.name: start
params.description: The earliest creation data for a generated theme to return, represented as milliseconds from epoch time

params.name: end
params.description: The latest creation date for a generated theme to return, represented as milleseconds from epoch time

params.name: cursor
params.description: A Base64 encoded string representing an opaque cursor position

params.name: limit
params.description: Specific number of results to return

params.name: sid
params.description: An integer id for a specific Survey

params.name: with_snapshots
params.description: true/false(default). If true, the API will return visitorSnapshots, which contains all events, attributes, triggeringEvent, and eventProperties set for the visitor at the time of survey delivery.

params.name: with_urls
params.description: true/false (default). If true, the API will return the page URL from which the survey was taken.

params.name: with_meta
params.description: true/false (default). If true, the API will return the metadata JSON blob containing details available from the client.

params.name: with_custom_metadata
params.description: true/false (default). If true, the API will return any custom metadata associated with the response (applicable to link platform surveys only).

params.name: with_deleted_responses
params.description: true/false (default). If true, the API will return the responses that have been previously deleted.

items.docs: Use this endpoint to retrieve responses from your studies. This endpoint allows you to retrieve up to 1000 responses at a time.
